title: Partizipation damals und heute
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: Alongside transparency, sustainability, and digitalization, the issue of participation is uniquely influencing the work done by institutions of culture and memory. Museums and memorials are familiar with participation, as they are often founded as the result of citizens’ special engagement. This volume focuses on the collection strategies employed by historical and Jewish museums, and institutions that heavily integrate public participation.
